identity.source_note: Live BMC guide URL 301-redirects to link.springer.com/journal/13102/submission-guidelines, which is bot-blocked (303 redirect to idp.springer.com/authorize Cloudflare/Imperva challenge shell) and returns no content via WebFetch or headless. Encoded from ≤12-month-old Wayback archive snapshots of the pre-migration BMC pages: general formatting page http://web.archive.org/web/20251114041138/https://bmcsportsscimedrehabil.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript ; research-article page http://web.archive.org/web/20250831175539/https://bmcsportsscimedrehabil.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/research-article ; review page http://web.archive.org/web/20251104091447/.../review ; systematic-review page http://web.archive.org/web/20251114205932/.../systematic-review ; index http://web.archive.org/web/20251113162200/.../submission-guidelines . All within 12 months of 2026-07-12; values are BMC cross-journal house-style plus this journal's own abstract cap and section orders.

encoding_notes: Publisher migration: the live BMC guide (bmcsportsscimedrehabil.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines) now 301-redirects to Springer Nature Link (link.springer.com/journal/13102/submission-guidelines), which is served behind an idp.springer.com/authorize Cloudflare/Imperva bot challenge and yields no readable content. Encoded from ≤12-month-old Wayback snapshots of the still-live BMC-hosted pages (Nov 2025 for general/index/review/systematic; Aug 2025 for research-article).

Article-type mapping: Research article->original_research; Review->review (BMC 'Review' = narrative literature review; distinct from the separate Systematic Review type); Systematic Review->systematic_review. The journal ALSO accepts Study protocol, Database article, Software article, Matters Arising, and Comment; none map cleanly to the enum (Study protocol/Database/Software have no slot; Matters Arising and Comment are post-publication correspondence-style types) so they were omitted per instructions. Case report and Technical advance were accepted historically but are ABSENT from the current (2025) submission-guidelines index and have no <=12mo snapshot, so they were dropped.

line_spacing=double from quick-point 'Use double line spacing'. line_numbers='continuous' and page_numbers.show=true from 'Include line and page numbering' (line numbering is required; continuous vs per_page is not explicitly stated, continuous is the BMC production standard). 'Do not use page breaks in your manuscript'.

Abstract: max 350 words ('The Abstract should not exceed 350 words'), do not cite references, minimize abbreviations. For Research and Systematic Review it is STRUCTURED with Background/Methods/Results/Conclusions (plus a conditional 'Trial registration' subsection for health-care-intervention trials). For the Review type the abstract is UNSTRUCTURED (no section labels prescribed) though still 350 words; the abstract block here encodes the structured Research/SR form as the primary type.
Keywords: 'Three to ten keywords representing the main content of the article' => min 3, max 10; case/separator unstated => null.

references.style=vancouver ('Examples of the Vancouver reference style are shown below'); order=cited (numbered); journal_abbrev=nlm ('Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE'); include_doi=true (DOIs shown in the example reference list); et_al_threshold=6 (example lists 6 authors then 'et al.': 'Rohrmann S, Overvad K, Bueno-de-Mesquita HB, Jakobsen MU, Egeberg R, Tjonneland A, et al.'). in_text marker (superscript vs bracket) is NOT explicitly stated in the guide => in_text=null (the only 'superscript' mention concerns table footnotes, not citations).

Figures: uploaded as separate files, numbered in order of first mention; accepted formats listed = EPS, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, BMP, CDX (only eps/pdf/tiff/jpeg/png fit the enum; Word/PowerPoint/BMP/CDX omitted). Resolution 'approximately 300 dpi at the final size' => min_dpi=300. Figure titles (max 15 words) and legends (max 300 words) go in the main manuscript, not the graphic => legends_location=figure_legends_section. Callout style ('Figure' vs 'Fig.') not explicitly stated => callout_style=null. Individual figure files <=10 MB.

Tables: numbered with Arabic numerals ('Table 1, Table 2'); small tables (< one A4/Letter page) placed in-text, larger tables at end of document => placement=in_text; 'Table titles (max 15 words) should be included above the table' => caption_position=above; legends (max 300 words) go beneath the table.

Declarations: mandatory 'Declarations' section with all subheadings in this order: Ethics approval and consent to participate; Consent for publication; Availability of data and materials; Competing interests; Funding; Authors' contributions; Acknowledgements; Authors' information (optional). Mapped: ethics_approval, patient_consent, data_availability, conflict_of_interest, funding, author_contributions, acknowledgments (Authors' information optional, no enum slot, omitted). All required ('All manuscripts must contain the following sections'; write 'Not applicable' if a section is not relevant).

Blinding: peer-review terminology on the journal page states 'Identity transparency: Single anonymized' => single-blind review, NOT double-blind. No separate anonymized/title-page requirement (title, authors and affiliations sit in the main manuscript). All blinding flags false.

ORCID and cover letter are not mentioned as hard requirements on the pages read => orcid_required=false, cover_letter_required=false (conservative). highlights_required=false (BMC does not use a Highlights section). No overall manuscript word limit, reference-count cap, figure count, or table count is stated for any type => all such caps null.

page_size null: guide references 'A4 or Letter page' when describing table/figure sizing but does not prescribe a page size for the manuscript itself. font family/size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, running_head, heading case all unstated => null.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
